hook: Animated clay story: a boy picks books over money, builds a bridge, and rows away with his dad
title: Books or money?
caption:
Two men offer a boy a choice: a stack of books or a stack of cash. In this animated clay-style story he builds a bridge, reads a glowing book, then rows out on the water with his dad.

What do you think the story is saying about what we hand our kids? Tell us in the comments.
